balls.text: perfect end to the innings as RP is castled by the yorker
RP is deceived by the slower delivery
short outside the off stump, Arjun finally connects the pull shot but does not get the timing right as he finds Chipli at deep square leg
RP makes room for himself and Steyn follows him . RP gets an inside edge onto the pitch as they run across for a single
short on the off stump, Arjun looks to pull it away and Vaas wants to get to the other end, but fails to beat the throw from Goswami and has to go back to pavilion
short on the off stump, Arjun looks to pull it away but the ball whizzes past him as he plays the shot
swinging away from off stump as Vaas has a wild swing and misses it. Three times in a row has that happened now
on a good length on the middle stump, Vaas swings and misses again
Vaas has a wild swing and misses

Bangar's batting duties end without facing a ball as Arjun plays the ball down onto the pitch and calls him across for a single, but Vinay is alert to the situation as he runs across, picks the ball up and throws the stumps down at the keeper's end
Vinay has his man as he bowls a fuller one on the middle stump, Venu looks to play it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge to extra cover, where Jaffer takes the catch
Vinay delivers a beamer here as Venu is already down the track and looks to pull it away and gets a top edge over the keeper's head for a boundary
on the off stump, Arjun pushes it to cover for a single
on the middle stump, Arjun drives it to long on and the keeper asks the bowler to field it, but how ?
fuller on the middle stump, Arjun launches it to long on for a six. Timely hit that
fuller on the leg stump, Arjun drives it back to the bowler
Timber! Teja moves across and looks to slog it away to midwicket but misses the line completely as the stumps are disturbed and he has to inch his way back to the pavilion
outside the off stump, Venu steers it away to short third man for a single
on the leg stump, Teja paddles it to short fine leg for a single
fuller on the middle stump, Venu comes down the track and lofts it straight down the ground to get 16 off the final three deliveries
on the leg stump, Venu comes charging down the track as he pushes it in the gap between deep square leg deep midwicket for a boundary
on a good length on the off stump, Venu comes down the track and lofts it to extra cover stands. Boy! what a shot
on the middle stump, Teja looks to run it down to third man but misses and is struck high on the pads as the appeal is negated
on the off stump, Venu comes down the track and looks to loft it away but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a single
outside the off stump, Venu pushes it to point
on the off stump and coming in, Teja looks to play it away on the leg side but gets a leading edge back to the bowler
fuller in length outside the off stump, Venu drives it to long off for a single
outside the off stump, Teja steers it to third man for a single
on a good length outside the off stump, Teja deftly runs it down to third man for a boundary
outside the off stump, Venu pushes it to covers for a single
outside the off stump and on a good length, Teja steers it away to third man for a single

on a good length outside the off stump, Rohit comes down the track and looks to loft it over long off but gets a top edge which flies towards sweeper on the off side and Steyn takes the catch comfortably
on the off stump, Rohit pushes it back to the bowler
fuller on the middle and leg, Rohit moves back and makes room for himself as he goes inside out to deep extra cover for a glorious boundary
on the middle stump and a little slower in pace as Rohit pushes it to midwicket
on the middle stump, Rohit gets an inside edge back onto the pitch
short on the middle stump, Rohit comes down the track and pulls it to deep square leg, where an athletic effort from Misbah limits them to a couple
fuller on the middle and leg as Rohit chips it to long on for a single
wide down the leg side
Free Hit! Full toss on the leg stump, Venu launches it to deep midwicket but there are two players stationed there and only gets a single
Kohli oversteps as Rohit guides it to square leg for a single
outside the off stump, Rohit Sharma looks to open the face and run it away to third man but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a couple
outside the off stump, Venu steers it away to short third man for a single

on the good length outside the off stump, Silva looks to drill through the off side and gets a faint nick back to the keeper, who does very well to hold onto it and then appeal. Rauf has no hesitation in giving it out and rightly so
on the middle stump, Silva turns it to square leg
short outside the off stump and moving away a touch. Rohit plays an ugly looking pull and is lucky not to have got any wood onto it
outside the off stump and swinging in sharply and also has nippy bounce. The bounce takes Rohit by surprise as he takes the bottom hand away from the handle and is struck on the fingers
short on the off stump, Rohit shifts his weight onto the backfoot and defends

Vinay gets it right this time as he pitches a full length delivery outside the off stump, Gilchrist goes for the lofted shot again but is not able to long off, where Akhil takes the catch running forward
fuller on the middle stump, Gilchrist looks to loft it but gets an under edge back to the bowler
short outside the off stump, Rohit stands tall and punches it through covers for a single
on the middle stump, Rohit drives it to mid on for a single
soothing it is to see Rohit Sharma bat as he plays the late cut to third man for a boundary. There was no power involved in the shot and it was all grace
fuller in length outside the off stump, Gilchrist drives it to mid off for a single
full toss on the leg stump, Rohit guides it to deep midwicket for a single
bounce does it  as Gibbs is far down the track and is deceived which allows Goswami to fumble with the ball once and still whip the bails off. Bowling change has worked for the Royal Challengers
outside the off stump, Gibbs looks to steer it away but cant beat the short third man fielder
full outside the off stump, Gilchrist wont let go of these as he drills it past extra cover to bring up the hundred partnership
on the off stump, Gilchrist drives it to cover
fetch that! a full length delivery is driven straight down the ground as it reaches the fence before three could be counted
on the good length outside the off stump, Gilchrist drives it back to the bowler
this time an even better shot as Gilchrist slaps it away over square leg for another six and he is looking dangerous now
well Gilchrist getting on now as he launches a full length delivery from Akhil into the stands as he gets himself a six
